_comment: The mock Steam Web API's data (mock-romm/mock-steam.mjs) and the fake steam's install names (fake-tools/steam.mjs). Fake app ids and accounts; no real key. `owned` is GetOwnedGames per SteamID64 (…0002 has private game details and answers {}); `apps` is what GetItems says per app id (type 0 game, 6 software); `tools` answer GetItems with success 15. The installed games (Moonlit Ferry, Deep Field Radio, Old Brick Road) are in the fake root, not in the owned list, so Connect reads `4 games owned` (Desk Lights is software and Proton a tool).
